title: Beyond Prompt Engineering: Neuro-Symbolic-Causal Architecture for Robust Multi-Objective AI Agents
tldr: Chimera, a neuro-symbolic-causal architecture integrating LLM reasoning with formally verified symbolic constraints and causal inference, achieves 130-198% higher profit than LLM-only agents while maintaining zero constraint violations.
problem_and_motivation: LLM-based autonomous agents exhibit catastrophic brittleness when deployed in high-stakes multi-objective decision-making, producing wildly different outcomes depending solely on prompt framing. Existing LLM agent frameworks lack hard safety guarantees and cannot anticipate long-term causal consequences of decisions, leading to either catastrophic failures or unsustainable outcomes that destroy brand trust.
approach: Introduced Chimera, a neuro-symbolic-causal architecture integrating GPT-4o for strategic reasoning, a TLA+ formally verified symbolic constraint engine, and an EconML CausalForestDML inference module.
Built EcommerceSimulatorV5, a discrete-event simulator modeling price elasticity, brand trust dynamics, advertising returns, and seasonal demand over 52-week business cycles.
Compared three architectures: LLM-only, LLM+Guardian (symbolic constraints only), and Chimera (full integration) across neutral and biased organizational prompt conditions.
Applied TLA+ formal verification to prove zero constraint violations across 174 million explored states.
Conducted trust multiplier sensitivity analysis across five organizational risk preference settings ranging from aggressive to conservative.
Used identical GPT-4o API configurations across all agents, isolating architectural differences from foundation model capabilities.
findings: num: Chimera achieves 130-198% higher profit than LLM-only baselines across all scenarios.
num: LLM-only agents fail catastrophically with -$99K total loss under volume-focused organizational bias.
num: Chimera delivers $1.52M and $1.96M profit in volume and margin scenarios respectively.
num: Zero constraint violations across 174,268,417 states verified by TLA+ model checker.
num: Chimera builds brand trust to +10.8% under margin-focused bias while LLM-only destroys trust by -48.6%.
num: LLM+Guardian achieves only 43-87% of Chimera's profit despite preventing catastrophic failures.
num: Chimera Sharpe ratios reach 6.18-8.272 compared to LLM-only's 2.47 under neutral conditions.
Chimera consistently delivers highest returns across all organizational bias conditions while improving brand trust.
Architectural design determines agent reliability more than prompt engineering when comparing across identical task definitions.
Causal engine enables self-correction where LLM overrides biased instructions based on counterfactual predictions.

key_equations.explanation: CATE estimation where do-operator represents causal intervention rather than correlation.

key_equations.equation: Q_t = D_{base} \times f_{price}(p_t) \times f_{trust}(\tau_t) \times f_{ad}(a_t) \times f_{season}(t)
key_equations.explanation: Multiplicative demand model combining price elasticity, trust, advertising, and seasonality factors.

key_equations.equation: \tau_{t+1} = \tau_t + \eta \times \{+0.02 \text{ if price decreases or stable}; -0.1 \times \Delta\% \text{ if price increases}\}
key_equations.explanation: Asymmetric brand trust dynamics where price increases erode trust faster than decreases build it.
Weekly profit computation combining unit margin, demand volume, fixed costs, and advertising spend.

definitions.definition: A three-component system integrating neural strategic reasoning, formally verified symbolic constraint enforcement, and causal counterfactual prediction.
A formally verified Guardian module that validates and repairs proposed actions against business logic constraints using TLA+ specifications.
Counterfactual reasoning using interventional do-calculus to predict long-term consequences of actions rather than relying on correlational predictions.
Temporal Logic of Actions, a formal specification language used to model-check concurrent systems and prove safety invariants across all possible states.
Conditional Average Treatment Effect, the expected difference in outcomes between treated and untreated actions given a specific state.
A risk-adjusted performance metric calculated as mean profit divided by standard deviation of weekly returns.

topic_relevance.contribution_to_field: The paper introduces the first neuro-symbolic-causal framework specifically designed for multi-objective decision-making under organizational constraints, with formal TLA+ safety verification. It provides empirical evidence across 156 weeks of simulated operation that architectural design determines agent reliability more than prompt engineering, with Chimera achieving 130-198% higher profit than LLM-only baselines while maintaining zero constraint violations. The work establishes that autonomous agents in high-stakes domains require complementary systems providing verifiable constraint enforcement and counterfactual prediction, not merely improved prompting.
directly_justifies: Chimera achieves 130-198% higher profit than LLM-only baselines while maintaining zero constraint violations.
TLA+ formal verification proves zero invariant violations across 174,268,417 explored states.
LLM-only agents produce catastrophic failures in 8-11% of decisions when operating without architectural guardrails.
LLM+Guardian prevents disasters but achieves only 43-87% of Chimera's profit due to lack of causal foresight.
Causal engine enables self-correction where agent overrides biased organizational instructions based on counterfactual predictions.
limits: Evaluation uses a single e-commerce simulation domain with parameterized dynamics rather than real market data.
Results are based on a single random seed trial without statistical confidence intervals across multiple runs.
Causal engine may suffer cold-start problems when facing genuinely novel scenarios outside training distribution.
Computational overhead of 3-5x decision time compared to LLM-only agents may prohibit latency-critical applications.
Multi-agent competitive dynamics and equilibrium properties remain unexplored in this work.

limitations: Evaluation is limited to a single e-commerce simulation domain with parameterized dynamics rather than ground truth from actual market data.
Results represent a single trial from the simulator's distribution using a fixed random seed, without statistical confidence intervals across multiple runs.
Causal engine relies on a pre-trained model and may suffer cold-start problems when facing genuinely novel scenarios outside training distribution.
Computational overhead of approximately 3-5x decision time compared to LLM-only agents may be prohibitive for latency-critical applications.
Multi-agent competitive dynamics and equilibrium properties remain unexplored, limiting claims about deployment in competitive market settings.
